products.name: Bendigo Express Home Loan
products.description:
The Bendigo Express is an online home loan which enables a customer to apply and be approved for a home loan re-finance
digitally. The application form will be hosted by our partner Tiimely.

features.additionalInfo: Up to six offset accounts can be connected to the product
Unlimited additional repayments if variable, otherwise 20% of loan balance when fixed

eligibility.additionalInfo: Credit and Lending Criteria, Fees and Charges Apply
Minimum loan amount $10,000. Maximum loan amount $3m

fees.name: Establishment Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Application Fee $0

fees.name: Valuation Fee
fees.additionalInfo:
Valuation fees (charged at cost, per property):

Electronic valuation: $134.20
Full valuation - less than $1 million in value: $220
Full valuation - greater than $1 million in value: $440

fees.name: Break Cost Fee and Prepayment Fee
fees.additionalInfo:
A Break Cost Fee is payable to us each time any of the following break events occur during a fixed rate period:
•	at your request, we agree to vary your annual percentage rate; or
•	you repay your loan account balance in full.
A Prepayment Fee is payable to us if, during a fixed rate period, you prepay an amount (repay more than your required repayments) that exceeds 20% of:
•	if the fixed rate period started on the date we first advanced any part of the amount of credit, the amount of credit – in which case the prepayment amount is the amount you prepay during the fixed rate period less 20% of the amount of credit; or
•	if the fixed rate period started on a date after the date we first advanced any part of the amount of credit, the loan account balance at the start of the fixed rate period – in which case the prepayment amount is the amount you prepay less 20% of the loan account balance at the start of the fixed rate period.

fees.additionalInfo: Charged when completing a redraw online

fees.name: Agent Lodgement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable for an agent of the bank to attend the settlement of your property or lodging the security interests attached to your loan

fees.name: Manual Redraw Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time we agree to a redraw request you make otherwise than through Bendigo e-banking

fees.name: Settlement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Settlement Fee is payable at settlement

products.name: Single Parents (Bendigo Complete Home Loan)
products.description:
Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme - Single Parents mirrors the Bendigo Complete Home Loan offering a 100% offset account on both variable and fixed rates - allowing you to save interest.   

* Check Eligibility Criteria for Scheme Loans

features.additionalInfo: Up to six 100% Offset Accounts per loan
Unlimited additional repayments if variable, otherwise 20% of loan balance when fixed

eligibility.additionalInfo: Credit and Lending Criteria, Fees and Charges Apply
Check Eligibility Criteria for Scheme loans.

products.name: Bendigo Flex Home Loan
products.description: For customers who want flexibility to pay down their loan sooner and access additional features such as up to 6 offset accounts.

features.additionalInfo: Up to six 100% Offset Accounts per loan. Full offset if Variable or Fixed. Offsets for Bendigo Flex Home Loan must be in the same customer number as the home loan.
Unlimited additional repayments if variable, Max $20,000 p.a without penalty for fixed loans

fees.name: Break Cost Fee
fees.additionalInfo:
Payable each time any of the following Break Events occur during a Fixed Rate Period: 
• at your request, we agree to change the Annual Percentage Rate under your Contract; 
• you repay your Loan Account balance in full; or 
• you make an additional repayment (by repaying more than your required repayments 
under your Contract) where the total of all additional repayments you have made 
since the start of the Fixed Rate Period or, if later, the anniversary of that date, that 
exceeds $20,000.00.
